design.decision: Bid the kings as sure tricks and lead them early, instead of waiting for the ace to fall.
design.opponent: Revealed at Opening; an opponent holding the real [A] of that suit now faces a duplicate and can no longer count it as a guaranteed winner.
design.rationale: A pure upgrade with no card made worse, unlike seed-become-king (+0.9), which can downgrade aces. A team holds about two kings, so this is roughly cb-become-ace at uncommon with directed selection. Its shape (every card of one rank) is distinct from uc-junk-to-aces (a counted range).
design.draftText: Opening: Every [K] your team holds becomes an [A]

history.note: draft-uncommon: merged into ua-kings-become-aces, the same design (signature) from another cluster; the amount sweep decides the number.
